newsitem.title: CHINA: All Shanghai financial markets trade despite Deng.
newsitem.headline: All Shanghai financial markets trade despite Deng.

text.p: All of China's financial markets will remain open on Thursday despite the death of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, exchange officials said.
"Trading will go on as normal and we have no plan to close despite the bad news," said an official with the president's office of the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

Similar statements were made by officials of the Shanghai Metal Exchange, Shanghai Cereals and Oils Exchange, the Shanghai-based local currency interbank market and the China Foreign Exchange Trade System, the interbank foreign exchange trading market.
